description: Routing labels for the Iris question router (tracker 337 N-G4). expect: product = a question about Correlix itself (docs, how-to, a screen, a decline the product answer handles); rca = live incidents/state; investigation = a troubleshooting method; not_product = anything but a product answer (live data or state). Scored by ai/routing_scoreboard_test.go on the router's FIRST claim. Questions only the data arm claims (they need the real grammar) are scored by the N-C6 compiler corpus, not here.
